request.amount_ada: none requested; proposed Net Change Limit is 500,000,000 ada
request.deadline: period begins at the start of Epoch 613 (February 13, 2026) and ends at the close of Epoch 713 (on or about July 3, 2027)
deliverables: Set a 500,000,000 ada Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Count all Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the period toward the limit
Use cumulative ledger-recorded Treasury Withdrawals in lovelace for limit accounting
Record DRep agreement if Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake
request.what: Record DRep agreement to a new Net Change Limit for the Cardano Treasury for Epochs 613-713 through an InfoAction with no direct on-chain effect and no authorization of any Treasury Withdrawal.

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Cardano Treasury Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for Epochs 613-713.
The proposed Net Change Limit caps only the total lovelace removed from the Treasury by enacted Treasury Withdrawals recorded on the Cardano ledger during the period.
Treasury inflows, including reserve and protocol allocations, transaction-fee allocations, refunds, and returned Treasury-funded amounts, do not count toward or increase the proposed limit.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the Epochs 613-713 period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada limit.
The proposal states that the new limit supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same period, including a previously agreed 350,000,000 ada limit.
The proposer asserts that the existing 350,000,000 ada limit has been useful but that practical room under it is becoming constrained.
The proposal says it does not mandate spending and that DReps retain discretion to approve or reject each Treasury Withdrawal on its merits.
The proposer states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are the threshold for agreeing a Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a.
The proposal claims it is drafted to comply with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and cites an IPFS reference to the constitution.
The proposal asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document proposes an InfoAction to signal agreement to raise the Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 to 500,000,000 ada, with ledger-based withdrawal accounting, prior-period withdrawals included, inflows excluded, and no direct withdrawal authorization.
